report.summary: All 26 tests errored in the shared session fixture base_url (tests/conftest.py:65) before any test body ran: the Bookshelf uvicorn process exited with code 1 during startup. The application code shows no defect that would do this on every start, so treat this as an environment problem. First step: rerun the suite with the app's stderr visible (the Popen call does not capture it) or run `python -m uvicorn app.main:app` from the repo root with the same env to read the real traceback.

causes.title: Uvicorn app process exits with code 1 at startup, so the session base_url fixture cannot start the server
causes.explanation: The base_url fixture starts the app as a subprocess and polls /health. The poll loop sees the process already dead and raises RuntimeError before any test runs, so every test that depends on base_url (directly or through api, user, new_user, anon_api, other_api) errors at setup. The app's own stderr is not piped or logged, so the actual exception is not in the report. Code reading found nothing that fails on every start: app/main.py creates the SQLite schema at import time (lines 68-69) using DB_PATH, and the only startup-time inputs are DB_PATH, BUGS and the installed packages. The likeliest causes are environmental: (a) the Python environment running the app is missing a dependency from requirements.txt (fastapi, uvicorn, jinja2, python-multipart), so the import fails; (b) APP_DB_PATH or DB_PATH points to a directory that does not exist or is not writable, so sqlite3.connect fails at import; (c) the import fails for another environment reason. The run was made on a local Windows machine (C:/Users/IvanPosavec/..., qa-lab\.venv), not the ubuntu-latest CI job in .github/workflows/tests.yml, so the environment differs from CI. This is not a product bug: the behavior under test never ran.
evidence: tests\conftest.py:35: RuntimeError: App exited early with code 1 (from _wait_until_up, which raises when proc.poll() is not None)
tests\conftest.py:58-62: subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-m", "uvicorn", "app.main:app", ...], cwd=ROOT, env=env) with no stdout/stderr capture, so the app's traceback is lost
app/main.py:68-69: `with db() as _conn: _conn.executescript(SCHEMA)` runs at import time, so a DB path problem makes the app exit during startup
Popen repr in the failure: returncode: 1, args ['C:\\Users\\IvanPosavec\\Documents\\qa-lab\\.ve...'] shows a local Windows virtualenv, not the CI runner
All 26 errors have the identical message, so the failure is at the shared session fixture, not in any individual test
causes.suggested_fix: 1) Capture the app's output: change the Popen call in tests/conftest.py to pass stdout/stderr (for example to a log file under the pytest tmp dir) and include it in the RuntimeError message, so the next failure says why the app exited. 2) Reproduce by running `python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8001` from the repo root with the same env (DB_PATH, APP_DB_PATH if set) and check the traceback. 3) Confirm the venv has everything in requirements-dev.txt installed, and that APP_DB_PATH, if set, names an existing writable directory. 4) Rerun the suite; if it passes, the failure was environmental and needs no code change.
